Description

Revolutionize Global Financial Systems with Cutting-Edge Technology

Are you passionate about building transformative financial technologies that power global transactions? Join our team and design innovative solutions that will impact millions of customers worldwide, leveraging the most advanced cloud technologies available.

Elevator Pitch You'll be at the forefront of creating scalable financial systems that drive Amazon's global growth. In this role, you'll design and develop sophisticated software solutions that transform how financial transactions are processed, using state-of-the-art AWS cloud services to solve complex technological challenges.

About the Team We are a collaborative and forward-thinking group dedicated to building next-generation financial technologies. Our team values innovation, technical excellence, and creating solutions that make a meaningful difference. We're committed to solving complex problems and driving technological advancement in the financial sector.

Key job responsibilities

 Define high level and low level design for software solutions using the latest AWS technology in a large distributed environment.
 Define high-level and low-level architecture for distributed financial systems using modern AWS technologies.
 Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable and reliable software solutions for accounting and financial operations.
 Drive architecture and technology choices, ensuring alignment with long-term platform goals and scalability requirements.
 Implement and advocate engineering best practices, including automation, testing, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines.
 Leverage data and metrics to enhance system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency.
 Develop integration frameworks and APIs to streamline workflows and improve system interoperability.
 Maintain exceptional code quality standards with emphasis on security, readability, and maintainability.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Finance, Product, and Platform Engineering to deliver high-impact solutions.
 Drive continuous innovation through experimentation and adoption of modern technologies.
 Experience or exposure to AI/ML technologies is a strong plus, particularly in building intelligent, predictive, or automation-driven financial systems.

A day in the life

A Day in the Life Your day will be dynamic and impactful. You'll collaborate with world-class engineers, architect innovative solutions, and tackle complex technological challenges. Expect to dive deep into cloud technologies, design intricate software systems, and continuously push the boundaries of what's possible in financial technology.

About The Team

Amazon Financial Technology Team is looking for a results-oriented, driven software development engineer, who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable financial systems. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real-time. We need someone to design and develop services that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually.

Basic Qualifications

 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
 Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
 Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

parsed_resume.name: ONKAR KOTULE
parsed_resume.headline: Software Development Engineer (SDE-2) | Backend & Full-Stack | MERN | Azure | Mendix

professional_summary.content: Software Development Engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and full-stack applications across enterprise and startup environments. Strong expertise in API design, data modeling, and performance optimization, with hands-on experience designing transaction-safe and real-time systems. Proficient in developing high-performance, production-grade architectures using Node.js, MongoDB, and cloud platforms, with a focus on scalability, consistency, and clean system design. Proven ability to own features end-to-end and build reliable, scalable systems in production.

responsibilities: Designed and developed enterprise-scale applications across backend and frontend, optimizing state management, data flow, and UI performance for complex workflows.
Architected backend integrations and REST API layers for scalable communication across services
Built systems with role-based access control (RBAC), auditability, and secure data flows.
Owned features end-to-end, from requirement design and development to production deployment and post-release ownership.

projects.title: ShareSpace
bullet_points: Hierarchical file storage with optimized data modeling
Secure upload/download pipelines with access control
Soft delete (trash), restore & lifecycle management

projects.title: Export Control system
bullet_points: Converted rigid logic into config-driven architecture
Improved maintainability and reduced manual effort

projects.title: AI-Powered Investment Insights System
bullet_points: Designed LLM-based pipelines to generate structured investment reports
Implemented prompt engineering and response validation for consistent and reliable outputs
Built dynamic frontend components to render UI based on API-driven responses
Integrated AI-generated insights into applications for real-time user consumption

projects.title: Dangerous Goods Transport System
bullet_points: Slot booking system with workflow orchestration
Real-time notifications and approval pipelines

responsibilities: Built scalable backend services using Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, designing modular REST APIs with validation and error handling.
Developed frontend systems using Next.js and Redux Toolkit, implementing optimized state management and efficient data fetching.

Optimized frontend performance using: - Efficient state management and component reusability (React, Redux Toolkit). - Data fetching and caching strategies (TanStack Query). - Reduced unnecessary re-renders and improved UI responsiveness.
Improved system performance through MongoDB indexing, query optimization, and efficient schema design

projects.title: Expense management system
bullet_points: Designed and developed a production-grade expense management system handling multi-user financial transactions
Implemented: o Transaction-safe balance updates ensuring data consistency across users o Real-time expense tracking and settlement logic
Designed optimized data models and aggregation pipelines for analytics and reporting
Enhanced performance using compound indexes for high-frequency queries
Built the system with focus on scalability, concurrency handling, and data integrity

projects.title: Additional Systems Built
bullet_points: Built real-time communication features using event-driven architecture (Socket.IO)
Developed modular frontend systems with optimized data fetching & caching

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-104)

education.institution: Bharati Vidyapeeth College of Engineering, Pune
